run_parallel_threads: run a function across multiple args in parallel using thread pool with tqdm progress bar
run_parallel_threads_star_args: run a function with unpacked positional args in parallel using parallel_threads with star_args enabled
run_parallel_threads_kw_args: run a function with unpacked keyword args in parallel using parallel_threads with kw_args enabled
get_cpu_count: get the number of available CPUs for the current python process using cpu_count
run_parallel_threads_unordered: run a function in parallel with unordered results using parallel_threads with ordered_res disabled
